full_judgment:
Mohammad Anwarul Haque J.:- This Criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Misc. Case No. 119 of 2003 where the rule issued under section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashment of the criminal proceeding has been discharged. 

 2. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the said judgment of the High Court Division the accused petitioner Ajoy Krishna Dey has filed this criminal petition for leave to appeal alleging that the High Court Division has totally ignored the facts and circumstances of the case and failed to prevent the abuse of the process of the court causing unnecessary harassment of the accused-petitioner.
